fields: [pic=1]Did you hear about all the crazy stuff Mabel was up to?

I’ve heard a lot!
Except the part where you two came in.
[pic=6]See, love? I told you we should have just told the poor lad!
[pic=4]We had him running about just to come back to us!
[pic=7]Nonsense! We didn’t see everything, he woulda missed out on some juicy details!
There have been some seriously juicy details!
[pic=1]We wouldn’t want Rascal to miss out on those juicy details.
[pic=3]So where did Mabel’s story leave off?
I believe she just tuckered out Bucky.
[pic=2]Oh that’s right! GOSH, that was messy!

He seemed a bit reserved
telling the whole thing…
[pic=2]I suppose the chap’s not one to gloat…
[pic=6]Honestly it’s a wonder he can still be so… virile…
[pic=4]Right? Even our bodies are starting to slow down!
[pic=2]So there Scarlett and I were, cleaning up some empty glasses and bottles.
[pic=1]Penny and Augustus seemed to be having an engaging conversation about the festivities.
[pic=1]Dustin and Maverick had just settled down for a nap. I believe the coyotes had just finished up with them.
[pic=7]That’s right! They were heading toward Finley. He seemed pretty interested in their lil’ four-way…
[pic=2]And finally we come upon Bucky and Mabel…
[pic=6]Poor ole Bucky was plum-tuckered out afterward!
[pic=7]I could see it in his face, he needed sleep. So that’s when we took over!
[pic=3]We got the two of them cleaned up and tucked Bucky in our bed.
[pic=6]Afterward, Mabel was still rearing to go! That girl is CRAZY!
[pic=8]She asked if I had any toys lying around.
[pic=2]And it’s Scarlett we’re talking about, here. Of course she has toys laying around…
[pic=4]And what is that supposed to mean?
[pic=3]Just that you’re well prepared, love! Nothing more…
[pic=7]Mmhmm, you don’t seem to mind when I’ve always got something fun to stick up your bum!
[pic=2]Anywho, as I was saying. It looks like Mabel wanted to have some toy fun, and I had just the thing!
[pic=1]She always wanted to try this knotted toy I have, what better opportunity?
[pic=2]Gosh the gape on that lil’ mouse when you pulled that toy out…
[pic=3]WHEW, ok, I need to calm down…
[pic=7]Hah, I’ll take over dear, you run some cold water over your face.
I could use some cold water too…
[pic=2]Hah! So after that, we cleaned up Mabel AGAIN. And then she was totally spent.
[pic=3]So we tucked her in next to Bucky, and continued cleaning up from the party.
[pic=8]I think at that point, everyone was basically asleep.
[pic=3]Finley and the coyotes were cuddled up together at the foot of the bed.
[pic=7]Dustin and Maverick were passed out on some cushions.
[pic=8]It was about time to wind down ourselves, but then we saw Augustus and Penny off to the side…
[pic=7]Well, this doesn’t have to do with Mabel shenanigans… But an interesting bit of gossip none the less…
[pic=8]Now, I’m trying to respect their boundaries, as both of them are more private lovers…
[pic=1]But that’s also why this was so interesting!
[pic=8]Well, as far as I know, Augustus and Penny haven’t been too sexually active with eachother…
[pic=1]BUT as I said, they are much more private than most, so who knows.
[pic=7]At this point, we decided to duck out and give them their privacy.
[pic=2]And honestly good for Penny, I hope she keeps finding ways comfortable for her to get her rocks off!
[pic=1]Love, you didn’t mention the most interesting part…
[pic=2]Oh that’s right! Yes, here’s what was crazy.
[pic=7]Now the two were very quiet. Augustus was whispering under his breath talking to her…
[pic=8]And I kid you not, he kept calling her "Felicity."
[pic=2]No idea. There’s never been a critter here named that.
You haven’t asked them about it?
[pic=8]Naw… I kinda wanted them to have that moment for themselves. So I never asked.
[pic=7]Anyways, Peter and I were cleaning up some food and drinks, and then we see Augustus and Penny cuddled up.
[pic=1]Like QUITE close. Definitely up to something. So we quietly snuck our way closer…
[pic=7]Y’know… to make sure everything was ok. And not to creep on our friends…
[pic=3]Anywho that’s it. We finished a bit of cleaning.
[pic=1]Then Peter had a stiffy that "needed tending to." So after a minute or so we were asleep.
[pic=7]Anyways that’s the end of our part.
[pic=2]Gosh what a night though. Can’t wait for the next one!
I’ll be there, I’ll be there!
It does! I think I’ve got it all figured out.
I gotta let Mabel know what fun she got up to.
